decisions.reason: The mobile grinder line has not appeared on the website since 2018 and overlaps with grinders already withdrawn, so with no evidence that it meets the aspiration, consolidating its resources into the established business is the boundedly rational response.

The stationary electric fine shredder had little visibility from the start and has not been observed since, which signals a shortfall against the aspiration that slack no longer justifies carrying after the 2019 pruning.

The single-shaft pre-shredder line was the most prominent new product and fits the firm's stationary plant and recycling direction, so despite not being observed recently, management keeps it while it searches for clearer performance feedback.
